subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI visible history, and through which supported boundary?
rationale: The bug shape is clear from source, but the fix direction depends on maintainer intent for third-party Open WebUI persistence ownership, direct SQLite/schema coupling versus API or plugin/adapter integration, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill behavior.

options.title: Design opt-in sync contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI visible-history sync path with config, schema/version handling, tests, and live Open WebUI proof before implementation.

options.title: Route through plugin or adapter
options.body: Keep core lean by requiring this Open WebUI-specific mirror to live behind a plugin/integration boundary, adding only any missing core API seam if needed.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in sync contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI visible-history sync path with config, schema/version handling, tests, and live Open WebUI proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway chat/session history makes this the best available owner for the product and storage-boundary decision.
